args.rationale: Pyramided on the operative rule memo (matter doc 191). An Ohio court has personal jurisdiction over Karvella Presses LLC under the specific jurisdiction test, satisfying both prongs. General jurisdiction is not met because Karvella is incorporated in Indiana with its PPB in Fort Wayne, Indiana, and is therefore not domiciled in Ohio. However, specific jurisdiction is satisfied. Prong (a) Purposeful contacts: Karvella's sales director traveled to Ohio six times over eight months to demonstrate press models on Ostrander's Canton floor and to negotiate the supply contract, and Karvella signed that contract at Ostrander's Canton offices — these are purposeful, non-fortuitous, non-plaintiff-created contacts constituting purposeful availment of the Ohio forum. Prong (b) Nexus: the suit is Karvella's failure to deliver the very presses ordered under that same supply contract, so the claim arises out of and relates directly to those Ohio forum contacts. The memo's firm rule of decision confirms that a defendant who repeatedly traveled into the forum to solicit and negotiate the very contract being sued upon satisfies both prongs, which is precisely the fact pattern here. Accordingly, personal jurisdiction exists in the Ohio forum and the filing is approved.
